pair.title: Scan the code on the shop PC
pair.hint: On the PC: Settings > Phones on this network > Pair a device.
pair.notFound: The shop PC was not found. Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi and the app is open on the PC.
pair.badQr: This is not a pairing code from Phone Store.
pair.badAddress: Enter the PC address, for example 192.168.1.20.
pair.remoteHint: Type the code shown on the PC under Settings > Mobile devices > Link a phone from another network.
pair.remoteNotFound: The code was not accepted. Check it, make sure it is less than 10 minutes old, and that the shop PC is on with internet.
pair.badRemoteCode: The code has 16 letters and digits.
pair.notConfigured: This app version was built without the online access settings.

waiting.title: Waiting for the manager to approve on the PC
waiting.hint: On the PC, a form asks for this phone's role. This screen continues by itself.

offline.title: Not connected to the shop PC
offline.wifi: The phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the PC.
offline.pcOpen: The Phone Store app is open on the PC.
offline.setting: On the PC, “Allow phones on this network” is on.

update.appHint: The PC app is newer than this app. Install the latest version of the phone app.
update.pcHint: This app is newer than the PC app. Install the latest version on the shop PC.
update.availableHint: Version {{version}} is on the shop PC.

soon.title: Coming soon
soon.hint: This screen arrives in the next version of the app.

scan.title: Point the camera at the code
scan.denied: The camera is not allowed. Allow it in the phone's settings for this app.

lookup.hint: Type at least 2 characters, or scan an IMEI or a barcode.
lookup.notFoundCode: No phone or item has this code.

more.pairAgainBody: This phone forgets the shop PC and must scan a new code.
more.pairAgainWaiting: {{n}} operations are still waiting to be sent. If you pair again they are lost.

receive.title: Receive stock
receive.saveFailed: Not saved. The draft is kept on this phone: try again.
receive.discardBody: The scanned phones and accessories are removed from this phone.
receive.empty: Add at least one phone or accessory.
receive.uploadFailed: The photo could not be sent. Try again.

count.title: Count stock
count.joined: A count is already open for this scope: you joined it.
count.live: Other phones counting here show up within a few seconds.
count.applyBody: Accessories are set to the counted quantities, with a stock movement each. Phones are not changed: you decide on each missing phone afterwards.
count.reason_not_in_stock: Not in stock (sold or written off)

sell.swipe: Swipe a line to remove it.
sell.empty: Scan a phone or an accessory to start.
sell.unknown: No phone or accessory has this code
sell.noSession: No cash day is open on the PC. Open it on the PC first, then sell.
sell.failed: Not sold. The cart is kept: try again.
sell.todayEmpty: Nothing sold on this phone today.

rep.photoFailed: The photo could not be sent. Try again.
rep.printSlip: Print the slip at the counter
rep.mineNeedsEmployee: This phone has no employee: it cannot filter on its own repairs.

remote.reason_shop_offline: The shop PC is off or has no internet.
remote.reason_shop_blocked: Remote access for this shop is blocked.

sync.lastUpdated: The shop PC is out of reach. Showing this phone’s copy, updated {{when}}.

reason.imei_already_sold: This phone was already sold on the PC. Nothing from this sale was recorded. The manager decides on the PC, under Sell > Needs review.
reason.imei_exists: A phone with this IMEI is already in the PC’s stock. Nothing was recorded. The manager checks it on the PC, under Sell > Needs review.
reason.forbidden: This phone is not allowed to do this. Ask the manager.
reason.invalid_input: The PC refused the information. Do it again with the PC.
reason.not_found: Something it needed no longer exists on the PC. Do it again with the PC.
reason.default: The PC could not apply this. Ask the manager to check it on the PC.

pin.setHint: 4 to 6 digits. It is asked each time the app opens, to protect the shop’s data on this phone.
pin.label: PIN

mode.title: How will you use the app?
mode.connectedHint: The PC keeps the shop’s data. This phone works with it, in the shop or from outside.
mode.aloneHint: No PC needed. The whole shop runs on this phone, offline. You can move to a shop PC later.

alone.backupHint: The whole shop in one file. Keep it somewhere safe: your data exists only on this phone.
alone.debtDays: Days before a debt is overdue
alone.deviceHint: Give this ID to your seller to get your key.
alone.deviceMessage: Hello, here is my device ID for the license: {{id}}
alone.moveConfirm: The PC has my data: move
alone.moveWarn: This erases the data on this phone. Only continue when the PC shows the same sales and stock.
alone.moveStep1: Export a backup from this phone (Settings > Backup).
alone.moveStep2: In the PC app, restore that backup (Settings > Backup and restore).
alone.moveStep3: Come back here and confirm: the phone then connects to the PC.
alone.name: Name
alone.readOnly: The trial is over: you can look at everything but not change it. Activate a key.
alone.recoveryHint: Write it down. It is shown only once.
alone.restoreHint: A backup from this phone, another phone or the PC. It replaces everything here.
alone.restoreWarn: This replaces ALL data on this phone with the backup. Continue?
alone.backupBanner: Your data exists only on this phone. Export a backup.

printer.title: Printer
printer.chooseFirst: Choose a printer first: More > Printer
printer.hint: Pair the Bluetooth printer in Android Settings first, then pick it here.
printer.none: No paired printer found. Pair it in Android Bluetooth settings.
printer.cutHint: Turn on only if your printer has a cutter.

errors.printer_not_set: No printer chosen. Choose one in More > Printer.
errors.bt_off: Turn Bluetooth on, then try again.
errors.bt_permission: Allow Bluetooth for this app in Android Settings.
errors.printer_unreachable: Cannot reach the printer. Check it is on, close, and paired.
errors.bad_image: The document could not be prepared.
